completed_work: Created lib/fuzz.js exporting parseWordlist, probeSoft404 and createFuzzer.
parseWordlist trims lines, drops blank lines and '#' comments, dedupes and keeps first-seen order.
probeSoft404 fingerprints one random path (__recon_probe_<hex>__) and returns {sha256,size,status} or null on failure.
createFuzzer builds dir + encodeURI(word) for every directory x word pair and skips the whole run when the product exceeds maxPaths.
Hit statuses 200/204/301/302/307/401/403: soft-404 responses (sha256 match or relative size delta <= soft404Tolerance) increment softSkips and create no node.
Miss statuses 404/410 create no node; other statuses are ignored without counting an error.
Each finding upserts a node with origin='fuzz', attrs.fuzz=true, status, depth=parent depth+1, type page/asset/endpoint, and adds a 'fuzzed' edge from the directory node.
Requests are rate-limited by a concurrency-capped worker pool with a global delay between request starts; per-URL failures never throw and increment errors.
Local node:http/node:https GET used because lib/crawl.js exports only createCrawler; 10s default timeout, UA recon-graph/1.0, 1 MiB body cap, no redirect following.
Wrote .crush/plan.json with the fixed stage-4 worker split.

notes: lib/crawl.js exposes no public request helper (Object.keys === ['createCrawler']), so lib/fuzz.js carries its own minimal GET as specified.
Soft-404 comparison only applies when the reference probe itself returned a hit status, so a server with a genuine 404 for unknown paths cannot cause false skips.
createFuzzer returns {run}; run never throws and always resolves to {tested,hits,softSkips,errors}.
